# Rule Reference

API Guard ships **81 rules**. Every rule id is a configuration key in the `rules:` section of `apiguard.yaml`; every severity can be overridden per rule, and per context with the `ruleId@context` syntax (see the [configuration guide](configuration.md)).

- **Default kind:** removal
- **Contexts:** webhook
- **Trigger:** A top-level webhook was removed (OpenAPI 3.1).
- **Message template:** (see sample outputs below)

## Sample output

Each rule renders a human message from the change it detects. Sample messages with
representative values:

```
allOf-member-added: Request property `get` gained an allOf constraint
allOf-member-removed: Request property `get` lost an allOf constraint
anyOf-oneOf-member-added: Request property `get` gained an alternative schema
anyOf-oneOf-member-removed: Request property `get` lost an alternative schema
api-key-location-changed: API key `get` moved from `"old"` to `"new"`
callback-added: Callback added: `"new"`
callback-removed: Callback removed: `"old"`
const-added: Request property `get` must now be exactly `"new"`
const-changed: Request property `get` const changed from `"old"` to `"new"`
const-removed: Request property `get` const constraint removed
constraint-added: Request property `get` now requires get: "\"old\"" → "\"new\""
constraint-relaxed: Request property `get` constraint relaxed: get: "\"old\"" → "\"new\""
constraint-removed: Request property `get` constraint get: "\"old\"" → "\"new\"" removed
constraint-tightened: Request property `get` constraint tightened: get: "\"old\"" → "\"new\""
contact-changed: Contact changed from `"old"` to `"new"`
content-type-added: Media type `"new"` added to request
content-type-removed: Media type `"old"` removed from request
default-response-removed: Default response removed
description-changed: API description changed from `"old"` to `"new"`
discriminator-added: Request property `get` now requires a discriminator
discriminator-changed: Request property `get` discriminator changed
encoding-changed: Multipart encoding changed for `"old"` → `"new"`
enum-value-added: Request property `get` enum value `"new"` added
enum-value-removed: Request property `get` enum value `"old"` removed
external-docs-changed: External docs changed from `"old"` to `"new"`
```
